prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1391; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Cervical strain was diagnosed, and conservative management was initiated, including manual therapy, stretching, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Over 18 visits, treatment followed a typical clinical course, with frequency tapering as symptoms gradually resolved and function improved. Examination findings included paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced rotation, which support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and imaging-related findings were within normal limits. No prior injury or ongoing complaints involving the cervical spine are known to this provider. Two similar charges submitted on the same date of service are currently under administrative review to confirm they reflect separate, documented services. Patient was discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
